interpretation.navigation: Earlier milestones restore snapshots for comparison, not physical reversal; never run fluids backward.
interpretation.numerical_motion: Animate mechanisms; show supported endpoint values with units/time basis. No quantitative interpolation or fabricated intermediate curves.
interpretation.reset: Restore complete target state on jumps and replay; no accumulating resource counters or alternative overlays.
interpretation.concept_visibility: P2 and P3 hide all numerical panels including original water, energy, land and any heat results.
interpretation.unknowns: Null means Not established, never zero; M1 runoff remains Not quantified.
interpretation.scope: SF only. Community is a scenario handoff, not reviewed David implementation. Existing San José/Muhos packets are unchanged.

patterns.phase_time_basis: illustrative proposal replay; no calendar duration or baseline M1–M5 retrofit history

One pair-wide replay control: both buildings need no heat, so useful delivery to both stops; computing continues and original cooling handles heat rejection.
Restore the proposed two-building active state when the pair-wide demand control is on; no full-time utilisation assumed.
